newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY LARGELY EASIER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY LARGELY EASIER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Wednesday's interbank trading session weaker against most hard units with the exception of the mark against which it firmed a little, dealers said.
"There was some good two-way trade today but nothing much happened really. The rates didn't move much at all," said one dealer, confirming what another dealer predicted in the morning.
The Zimbabwe dollar closed at 11.3050/3150 against the key U.S. dollar, half a cent weaker compared to Tuesday's 11.3000/3100.

On the crosses, it eased against sterling to 18.5070/5370 from 18.4300/4500 and to 2.5230/5270 against the rand from 2.5200/5400. However against the mark it was quoted firmer at 6.6235/6330 compared to 6.6500/6700.
